product.title: Comfort & Health Kit
product.body_html:
Comfort, hydration, and rest — covered.

The complete Wagvive comfort set — cooling mat, anti-spill floating water bowl, slow feeder bowl, and orthopedic bed — designed around the daily habits that matter most for health and comfort. Especially built with senior dogs in mind, but valuable for any owner who wants to upgrade the basics.

This kit includes:

  • Cooling Comfort Mat
  • Anti-Spill Floating Water Bowl
  • Slow Feeder Bowl
  • Orthopedic Comfort Bed

Save $53 compared to buying each item separately.
